headline: China Mandates 70% Homegrown Silicon Wafer Use, Accelerating Chip Self-Sufficiency Amid Export Controls
summary: Beijing's directive for 70% domestic silicon wafer production is a significant escalation of its tech localization drive, aimed at insulating its semiconductor industry from Western export restrictions and fueling its AI ambitions. This move will profoundly reshape the global semiconductor supply chain, increasing geopolitical decoupling and potentially creating distinct tech ecosystems.
